scope: General event alert notification location lineage
focused_checks: A valid event payload location_id is forwarded to the durable notification outbox INSERT.
A malformed location UUID raises before the handler opens a database cursor or executes SQL.
A notification with no configured destination and no source event ID returns without opening a database connection.
A repeated source-event/channel/destination with matching payload and location remains idempotent.
Existing outbox checks preserve NULL-lineage retry fill and reject conflicting location lineage.
limitations: All handler database interactions used mocks; no database, candidate, or legacy service was contacted.
The event payload location is optional, non-authoritative lineage and does not authorize tenant access or establish signed worker context.
No external notification provider was contacted.
